title: diplotaxis saxatilis subsp. humilis
intro: Diplotaxis saxatilis subsp. humilis, commonly known as the lesser wall rocket, is a subspecies of perennial plant in the Brassicaceae family, characterized by its compact growth habit and edible leaves. The plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Diplotaxis saxatilis subsp. humilis include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
